title: Abelian etale sheaves on a field and discrete G-modules
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], K^sep a separable closure, and G=Gal(K^sep/K). Taking the geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] at Spec K^sep induces an equivalence between abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on the small etale site of Spec K and discrete G-modules. The equivalence is compatible with the underlying sheaf-of-sets/G-set equivalence and with the abelian group operations.

source.place: Tag 04JQ, Lemma lemma-equivalence-abelian-sheaves-point, deduced from Tag 03QT

proof.text: By the sheaf-of-sets point equivalence, taking the geometric stalk at Spec K^sep identifies sheaves of sets on the small etale site of Spec K with discrete G-sets, where G = Gal(K^sep/K), and the identification is the stalk functor used in the statement.

An abelian sheaf is a sheaf of sets equipped with a commutative group law, and a discrete G-module is a discrete G-set equipped with a commutative group law whose operations are G-equivariant. The product-preserving equivalence therefore transports the addition, zero, and inverse operations and their morphisms, giving an equivalence of the corresponding abelian categories, compatible with the underlying sheaf-of-sets/G-set equivalence and with all abelian group operations.
